notes: PERKS: every class now has 3 perk slots - one from each tier (blue, red, green), 5 perks per tier including the new Endurance, Prowler and Iron Skin. Every perk now really does what it says
HITBOXES: headshots do the most damage, then chest, then stomach, then arms and legs (lower arms and legs least). Getting shot knocks your aim a little
DAMAGE RANGE: every gun does full damage up to its MAX DAMAGE RANGE, then less further away (SMGs and pistols drop off the most, snipers not at all)
BALANCE: SMGs do less damage, pistols toned down (only the revolver one-shots a head), short delay before you can shoot after sprinting
CONTROLLER: every button in menus and the lobby can be reached, popups and friend requests too, an on-screen keyboard for typing, and a clear gold ring shows where you are
SAVES: your stats, classes and settings now have a backup, so an update can never wipe them
